newsitem.title: UK: S&P raises Kingfisher outlook to stable.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises Kingfisher outlook to stable.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it had affirmed its A minus senior unsecured and A2 commercial paper ratings of Kingfisher Plc and revised the outlook to stable from negative.

"The stable outlook reflects S&P's belief that Kingfisher will sustain its improved operating performance and maintain its credit profile, despite intense competition in all of its markets," S&P said in a statement.
It said current ratings did not factor in large debt financed acquisition.

"Kingfisher Plc's ratings reflect the group's well-positioned, diversified range of retail operations in the UK and France, together with an improving financial profile due to recently increased operating efficiency and better store performance," S&P said.
Going forward, S&P said it expected Kingfisher's net debt to remain at its current lower level.

"The group's ongoing high capital expenditures for store remodeling and new store openings as well as small opportunistic add-on acquisitions should be financed from the group's operating cash flow," the agency said.
